demoInstructions: 1) cd fixtures/autofix-demo && npm install  2) From repo root: node index.js --config=agent.autofix-demo.config.json  With unit.demoInjectFailingAssertion true (default in that config), the bot appends a failing expect(tipPct(99.99)).toBe(20) so Jest fails once, then autofix repairs. Set demoInjectFailingAssertion false for normal runs.

stories.title: Tiered tip percentage for checkout
stories.description: Given the pre-tax subtotal in dollars, tipPct must return the suggested gratuity rate as a whole-number percentage (not a decimal fraction). When the subtotal is strictly below 100, the rate is 18. When the subtotal is 100 or greater, the rate is 15. Non-numeric input should yield 0. Cover boundary values 99.99, 100, and 0.
